$comment: Packages outside the permissive list, each reviewed and accepted (ADR-0012). Matched by package name (a trailing * matches platform variants) and the exact licence string pnpm reports.

exceptions.reason: libvips, the image library sharp loads for Next.js image handling. Dynamically linked and unmodified, which LGPL allows; it is not part of our code.
Build-time tool that uploads source maps; not shipped to users. Functional Source Licence, becoming MIT two years after each release; our use is permitted.

The newer Sentry CLI, pulled in by @sentry/nextjs 11's build plugin to upload source maps; build-time only, not shipped to users. Functional Source Licence, becoming Apache-2.0 two years after each release; our use is permitted.
Accessibility checks in tests only; never shipped. Unmodified, so MPL's file-level copyleft asks nothing of us.
CSS compiler used at build time by Tailwind; its output is our CSS, not the tool. Unmodified.
Browser support data used at build time by Browserslist; attribution is in its package, nothing of it ships.

Fonts for the Integr8 Media look (Unbounded, Inter, JetBrains Mono, Alexandria, IBM Plex Sans Arabic), bundled unmodified into the web and staff desktop apps. The SIL Open Font License allows using, embedding and shipping the fonts with software; it only forbids selling the fonts on their own or renaming modified copies, neither of which we do.
